name: topo-lines
title: Topo Lines
description: Topographic contour lines around a few seeded peaks breathe and drift, with index contours and one line picked out in the accent, as a seamless loop.
useWhen: A title, quote or section card needs a quiet line texture behind it that moves slowly enough to read over.
A story about terrain, exploration, maps, depth or data layers needs a survey-map look.
The background has to loop without a seam for any length of shot, in any brand color.
avoidWhen: The backdrop should be flowing strands rather than closed contours: use flow-field.
The background should be soft color with no lines.
The scene needs a rule-based geometric loop with distinct objects.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Peaks
variables.description: Number of peaks in the height field.

variables.label: Accent contour
variables.description: Contour drawn in the accent, counted from the lowest; -1 turns it off.

variables.label: Index line every
variables.description: Every n-th contour is a heavier index line; 0 turns it off.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Sampling cells across the short side; higher is smoother and slower.

variables.label: Loop frames
variables.description: Frames per seamless loop of the breathing field. The component lasts 10 s, so 300 loops once.
